headline_result.h19_status: CONFIRMED for the native side (robust statistic), NOT confirmed for the Solr side -- a genuine asymmetric finding
headline_result.native_combined_hit_rate: 20/20 runs showed >= 2x degradation on the native quiet tenant under combined load
headline_result.native_solo_ratio_anomaly: median ~1.00x-1.01x across 20 runs, not reproducing H14/H17's own ~30-40% hit rate -- traced to a shorter join()-bound measurement window, disclosed as a self-caught methodological subtlety, not used as the basis for the verdict
headline_result.solr_verdict: does not clear the pre-registered 1.25x bar
headline_result.named_limitation: only combined H14's/H15's base mechanisms, not H17's/H18's own burst-amplified versions; native-side mechanism (OS-level CPU/scheduling contention between the Rust process and the Solr JVM process) is a working hypothesis, not independently profiled
